published.source: Race pass on the client 70425 racials (raid hits, Savage, Ruthless, Earth Fury, Wind Blessed), master d511c09, 2026-10-16

verify.note: same sim as the published number (seed 1)

rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Adrenaline Rush under 39 energy while Slice and Dice is up
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper, Land Mine and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6s left); spend leftover points in the last 3s
Backstab right after a main-hand swing (0.25s), or at 100 energy
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Murder does nothing on the generic boss, so its points go to Lethality (Vile Poisons for Seal Fate Daggers).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir left out (+8 through Dragonbreath Chili).
